Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning an assessment of the department of transportation's management, accountability, and performance system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an assessment of the department oftransportation's management, accountability, and performance system;and adding a new section to chapter 47.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Within the amounts provided for the department's programdelivery management and support – program H in the 20112013 omnibustransportation appropriations act, one million dollars of the motorvehicle account-state appropriation must be held in unallotted statusby the office of financial management until the department hascompleted an agencywide, independent management, accountability, andperformance system assessment in accordance with subsection (2) of thissection. (2) Beginning in 2012, and at least once every three yearsthereafter, the department shall apply to the Washington state qualityaward, or similar organization, for an independent assessment of itsquality management, accountability, and performance system. Theassessment must evaluate the effectiveness of all elements of the p. 1 SB 5344department's management, accountability, and performance system,including leadership, strategic planning, customer focus, analysis andinformation, employee performance management, and process improvement.The purpose of the assessment is to recognize best practice andidentify improvement opportunities.
